# SUBLEASE AGREEMENT — OFFICE SPACE

Between MARTA REIS, owner of the unit at Rua do Alecrim 12, 2nd floor, Lisbon, and
TOMAS NOVAK, tenant of the mezzanine office, the following is agreed.

## FIRST CLAUSE
The unit is located at Rua do Alecrim 12, 2nd floor, parish of Encarnação, with use
permit no. 77 issued by the City Council and energy certificate no. SCE000111222.

## SECOND CLAUSE
The monthly rent is EUR 480.00, payable up to the 5th day of the month by bank transfer.
The deposit is EUR 480.00.

## THIRD CLAUSE
The contract starts on 3 November 2026 and terminates on 3 November 2028.

## FOURTH CLAUSE
The tenant shall keep the premises in good order and shall not remove any of the
fixtures without prior written consent of the owner.

## FIFTH CLAUSE
Either party may terminate this contract by giving one month of notice in writing.

## SIXTH CLAUSE
The parties agree that the air conditioning unit is repaired before the start date.
